cheat.note: just so that the enemy can't heal itself since it will always have full hp, but the enemy's HP WILL DECREASE AS HIT, this code is just for a non healing enemy, it will not take more or less damage than normal. As hit, current and MAX hp will go down equally until it reaches 0 and the enemy dies. =)

cheat.name: Enemy can't build walls
cheat.note: enemy walls hp=0, destroyed as formed. This will make RECENTLY enemy formed walls HP=0, thus destroying them at the same time of creation, it will not affect pre-battle formed walls! It will not make the enemy try to form new ones. When non-attacking undead units are killed, they still leave behind a 1hp wall, even if they look life BIG-BAD-STRONG-HIGH hp walls, they only have 1hp, and they will not fuse together and will occupy a lot of space and enemy unit count, which good cuz enemy will have less attacking units to call and you'll have to destroy 1hp walls instead of possible attacking units. =)
